conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Anil Thakur. Mera personal loan ka interest rate kyun badh gaya?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Anil ji, main aapke loan details check karta hoon. Kya aap apna loan account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, yeh hai L N 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1. Pehle 9% tha, ab 10% dikh raha hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, RBI ke new guidelines ke wajah se floating rate loans pe interest badha hai. Kya aap fixed rate pe switch karna chahte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, yeh better hai. Kaise karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main aapko process ke liye documents aur steps mail karta hoon. 3 din mein switch ho jayega. Theek hai?
